full_judgment: Mr. Md. Ruhul Amin:- This petition for leave to appeal is by the pre-emptee against the judgment and order dated November 28, 2001 of a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 2047 of 2000 making the Rule absolute upon setting aside the judgment and order dated March 12, 2000 of the 1st  Court of Subordinate Judge, Madaripur in Miscellaneous Appeal No.21 of 1999 reversing the judgment and order dated June 30, 1999 of the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Madaripur in Miscellaneous (pre-emption) Case No.37 of 1998 allowing the same tiled under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950, claiming to be a contiguous land holder.
